title: Generation and Verification: Human-Agent Collaboration for Safety-Critical Automotive Software Engineering
title_zh: 生成与验证：面向安全关键汽车软件工程的人机协作

paragraphs.en: 面向安全关键汽车软件的编码助手，通过领域微调与独立验证工具满足验证优先和狭窄领域要求。 Research on coding agents mainly focuses on generation quality. Yet, safety-critical automotive software makes two additional demands. It prioritizes verification, since every change is reviewed, traced to a requirement, and checked against industry standards such as MISRA and AUTOSAR before it can be committed. It is also a narrow domain, written against layered architectures, embedded resource constraints, and organization-specific interface conventions that are scarce in the data general-purpose LLMs are trained on. We present a coding assistant for automotive C/C++ that addresses both demands. First, it exposes three tools to the user over the Model Context Protocol (generate, edit, and verify), allowing developers to run verify on any code on demand rather than relying on the agent to check its own output. Second, rather than using a general-purpose model, we customize the underlying LLM for the automotive domain through prompt engineering and fine-tuning. We construct a dataset from automotive production code of AUMOVIO, where each function is paired with the requirement texts and Unified Modeling Language (UML) behavior it must satisfy. In a two-week pilot on active production projects, developers report verify as the most-used tool and confirm using it on their own code and not only on generated output. Comparing model customization strategies, 75% prefer the faster prompt-engineered configuration. MISRA- and AUTOSAR-inspired pattern checkers indicate that prompt engineering achieves a lower number of violations on C, while fine-tuning shows better conformance with architecture patterns for C++.
paragraphs.zh: 面向安全关键汽车软件的编码助手，通过领域微调与独立验证工具满足验证优先和狭窄领域要求。对编码智能体的研究主要集中于生成质量。 然而，安全关键的汽车软件还提出了两项额外要求。 它优先考虑验证，因为每一处更改都必须经过审查、追溯到需求，并对照 MISRA 和 AUTOSAR 等行业标准进行检查，然后才能提交。 它同时也是一个狭窄领域，代码需要遵循分层架构、嵌入式资源约束以及组织特有的接口约定，而这些在通用大语言模型的训练数据中十分稀缺。 我们提出一个面向汽车 C/C++ 的编码助手，以同时满足这两项要求。 首先，它通过模型上下文协议（Model Context Protocol）向用户暴露三个工具（生成、编辑和验证），使开发者能够按需对任意代码运行验证，而不是依赖智能体自行检查其输出。 其次，我们没有使用通用模型，而是通过提示工程和微调将底层大语言模型针对汽车领域进行定制。 我们基于 AUMOVIO 的汽车生产代码构建了一个数据集，其中每个函数都与它必须满足的需求文本和统一建模语言（UML）行为配对。 在为期两周、针对活跃生产项目的试点中，开发者报告验证是使用最多的工具，并确认他们会在自己的代码上使用它，而不仅仅是在生成的输出上。 在比较模型定制策略时，75% 的参与者更偏好速度更快的提示工程配置。 基于 MISRA 和 AUTOSAR 的模式检查器表明，提示工程在 C 语言上实现了更少的违规数量，而微调在 C++ 上展现出更好的架构模式符合性。
